ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The picture is a schematic map of Jiangsu Province, with the Yellow Sea marked on the east side, and the legend includes cities, railways, major roads, canals, petroleum, coal, iron ore, airports, ports, etc. The letter B is marked in the southeastern part of Jiangsu Province, near the lower reaches of the Yangtze River estuary area, and is located in a plain area with a dense water network.
